concept: A paper kite catches the dawn and its tail draws the launch lockup.

signatureShot.description: The kite crosses the sun while its tail resolves into the Northwind wordmark.
signatureShot.memorableBecause: One continuous gesture connects product, light and brand.

visualSystem.cameraLanguage: Measured dolly moves with no orbit-control drift.
visualSystem.materialTreatment: Layered translucent paper with fibres, folds and contact shadows.
visualSystem.negativeSpace: The upper-left sky stays dark and empty for the approved copy.

copyContrast.strategy: Reserve quiet tonal sky behind type; never add a rectangular panel.

shots.framing: Macro detail of folded paper against the dawn.
shots.secondaryReaction: Paper fibres lift and the tail responds to the unfold.
shots.lightAndMaterial: A warm edge light reveals paper texture and fold shadows.
shots.textTreatment: No copy; preserve the quiet sky for the next shot.

transition.mechanism: The tail sweeps across the lens

shots.framing: Wide left-negative-space composition with the kite on the right.

stateChange.to: Catch the wind revealed word by word

shots.primaryMotion: The kite climbs along the same tail trajectory.
shots.secondaryReaction: Tail bows flex after the climb and pollen drifts away from copy.
shots.lightAndMaterial: Bloom stays on the kite, never behind the headline.
shots.textTreatment: Masked per-word reveal with tracking settle and shallow extrusion.

transition.mechanism: The kite tail becomes an underline

shots.framing: Slow pull-back to the signature sun crossing and final brand lockup.
shots.primaryMotion: The kite crosses the sun as the tail writes the final underline.
shots.secondaryReaction: The hills settle at different parallax rates and the tail bows lag.
shots.lightAndMaterial: A single warm rim exposes translucent paper without a global glow.
shots.textTreatment: The launch line resolves into a stable lockup with a clean reading hold.

transition.mechanism: Settle into the final composed frame

events.action: First fold begins on the sting.
Headline starts after the opening gesture.
Signature move starts with the music change.

analysis.composition: Asymmetric right-weighted hero with open upper-left sky reserve.
analysis.silhouetteAndProportions: Tapered diamond kite with long 1:3 ribbon tail and crisp spar angles.
analysis.paletteAndContrast: Deep navy #12324A against warm apricot #F2A981 and cream #FFF6E5 highlights.
analysis.materialAndSurface: Translucent mulberry paper with directional fibre grain and crease shadows.
analysis.lightDirection: Low-angle backlight from 220deg casting warm translucent rim and spar shadow.
analysis.edgeAndContact: Soft 3px rim light wrap where the paper crosses the sun disc; crisp outer fold.
analysis.typeHierarchy: Display headline at 68px tracking -0.02em above quiet 24px subhead.
analysis.memorableFeature: The ribbon tail physically writes the baseline of the brand lockup.

shotMapping.transferablePrinciple: Backlit translucent paper rim and continuous ribbon-to-wordmark gesture.
shotMapping.howOursDiffers: Uses Northwind octagonal kite geometry and dawn hill parallax instead of studio cyclorama.

grain.visibleContribution: Adds tactile paper fibre micro-contrast on the kite sail without crawling.

gradientMesh.visibleContribution: Builds volumetric dawn horizon falloff while keeping upper-left copy reserve dark.

parameters.volumeIntent: Separate far hills from backlit kite silhouette and preserve 7:1 headline contrast.

depthBlur.naReason: Crisp vector paper craft direction keeps mid-ground silhouette sharp; foreground haze uses layer blur only.

lightWrap.visibleContribution: Wraps warm solar backlight around the kite inner edge and casts spar contact shadow.
